Cortex Context Pack Review

Use this for bounded review of a context pack or artifact-derived evidence bundle before it feeds a higher-level assistant or report flow.

Pack Identity

  • Purpose: monitor-index-comparison / source-review / other
  • Visibility: public / internal / protected
  • Query: short source query
  • Artifact version: id or timestamp

Evidence Review

QuestionResultNote
Expected project coverage presentyes / no / partialprojects included
Protected data handling correctyes / no / n/aallowlist or exclusion note
Freshness acceptableyes / no / uncleartimestamp or caveat
Approval boundary preservedyes / nowhy

Excluded Or Missing Evidence

  • missing source or stale source
  • protected evidence intentionally excluded
  • known retrieval gap

Decision

Mark the pack as ready, hold, or needs rebuild, and state the smallest required correction.
